title: Gower, Confessio Amantis VII.1310–1327
date: Work c.1390; electronic edition based on Macaulay
status: Primary text in later electronic edition, not manuscript collation
finding: Pliades / Clota with Cristall and Fenele; Aldeboran with Carbunculum and Anabulla. Verifies medieval fennel correspondence, not modern species identity of Anabulla.

title: Macaulay, introduction to Gower
finding: Dates first completion to 1390 using prologue date.

title: Tadhg Ó Cuinn, An Irish Materia Medica, subsection 28
date: Historical medical text in modern edited/translated presentation; manuscript dating not audited here
finding: Links Anabulla, titimaillus and spurge. Supports a spurge reading tradition; does not establish a universal modern taxon.

title: Agrippa, Occult Philosophy I.32
date: Renaissance work; 1651 English translation in electronic edition
status: Later primary witness; English translation wording
finding: Pleiades with fennel among other materials; Aldeboran with Milky Thistle and Matry-silva. English phrase is not proof of medieval Silybum marianum assignment. Latin scan search snippet was encountered but full scan fetch failed; Latin wording not independently verified in this audit.
